component.name: Paleto Modkit
component.summary: Mod GTA V on Linux: archives, mods folder and OIV packages

description.p: Paleto Modkit is a native Linux tool for modding Grand Theft Auto V, both the Legacy and the Enhanced edition. It opens the game's RPF archives, lets you change them and installs mods packaged as OIV files.

ul.li: Browse the game folder and its archives, nested archives included
Add, replace, extract and delete files, or drop them on the window
Edit XML and META files with syntax highlighting
View, export, replace, add and rename textures, importing PNG or DDS
Edit binary metadata (.ymap, .ytyp, .ymt, .pso) as XML and text tables (.gxt2) as text
Preview 3D models; play, export or replace game audio, radio songs included
Install OIV packages and add-on packs (dlc.rpf), with a preview of what they contain
On the Enhanced edition, convert models and textures made for Legacy
Export your own changes to the game as an OIV package
Check that the game loads the mods folder, and what it read in the last session
Read the game's last crash, find the mod that crashes it, and keep snapshots of the mods folder
Prepare the game's Wine prefix for ScriptHookVDotNet mods
Never touches the original game files: changes go to the mods folder

description.p: Encryption keys are not included: they are read from your own copy of the game. Loading the mods folder in game needs an ASI loader, installed separately. Paleto Modkit is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or the OpenIV team.

screenshot.caption: Archive browser with a 3D preview of a vehicle
Texture dictionary viewer: export, replace, add and rename textures
Audio container preview: play, export and replace sounds
OpenIV package (.oiv) installer targeting the mods folder

description.p: AppImage fixes for the AppImage catalog.

ul.li: The AppImage is built on Ubuntu 22.04, so it needs glibc 2.35 instead of 2.39 and runs on older distributions.
The AppImage carries libxkbcommon-x11, so it starts in an X11-only session.
The AppImage has update information and a .zsync file, so AppImageUpdate can update it.
The system theme falls back to light when the desktop states no colour preference.

description.p: Desktop entry fix for the AppImage catalog.

ul.li: The desktop file uses the standard X- prefix for the non-standard SingleMainWindow key, so it passes desktop-file-validate.

description.p: Prefix tweaks works for games that are not in Steam's library.

ul.li: When the game's Wine prefix is not found, Prefix tweaks offers Choose prefix folder: pick the game's compatdata folder (the one with pfx inside), for example a non-Steam game added to Steam or a Faugus prefix. The choice is remembered; Use Steam's prefix again forgets it. From a terminal: paleto prefix use PATH.
For a prefix whose pfx is a link to its own folder (Faugus), the window warns that the game must be closed first and that Restore is not supported; backups still work.

description.p: Updated interface toolkit, with the icons drawn from bundled fonts.

ul.li: Icons and symbols in buttons and labels are centred on the text. They come from fonts bundled with the app, so they look the same on every system.
Format on an XML file also removes the blank lines between tags, besides indenting.
The Mods in game window keeps its buttons on screen in a small window.
Updated egui, the cryptography crates, the zip library and the Wayland toolkit.
The Flatpak is built from the source tree instead of a fixed commit. The converter script works with podman when .NET is not installed.

description.p: Prefix tweaks asks for the permission it needs, step by step.

ul.li: Without the permission to run Wine on the host, Prefix tweaks shows only how to grant it: copy the command, run it in a terminal, then close and reopen the app, and check again. To successfuly apply the permission the app needs to be restarted.
The copy and check buttons show a small icon for the result.
The Original and Mods copy switch buttons centre their label.
The project moved to the PaletoModkit repository; links are updated.

description.p: Prefix tweaks now works in the Flatpak.

ul.li: In the Flatpak, Wine runs on the host through flatpak-spawn, because the sandbox does not allow the 32-bit processes of Proton's Wine. This needs the permission to talk to org.freedesktop.Flatpak, which the Flatpak now asks for.
Without that permission, Prefix tweaks shows a warning with the command to grant it, instead of crashing.
Release files are named PaletoModkit-x86_64 followed by the extension.
